description: This chart illustrates the distribution of target counts within a collection of hateful communication datasets across several years. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with categories labeled 2012 through 2022, listed in sequential order. The vertical axis represents a proportion, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals, and is labeled “Proportion.” Each year is represented by a stacked bar, composed of segments corresponding to different target counts. The target counts are categorized as “0,” “1,” “2-4,” “5-7,” and “8+”, represented by blue, orange, green, red, and purple segments, respectively. For example, in 2012, the blue segment reaches approximately 0.95, the orange segment reaches approximately 0.05, and the other segments are not present. In 2018, the blue segment reaches approximately 0.4, the orange segment reaches approximately 0.3, the green segment reaches approximately 0.2, the red segment reaches approximately 0.07, and the purple segment reaches approximately 0.03. The bars are not sorted by any apparent criteria, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation. A legend in the upper right corner clarifies the color coding for each target count category.
